contract.import: importlib.util.spec_from_file_location; execute module without main; verify module SHA256 before import
contract.configuration: Set OUT to external evidence directory; set ENV explicitly for browser preserving required memory constraints and removal of NODE_TEST_CONTEXT. ROOT is used for inventory, not ownership. run returns None on success and raises RuntimeError on nonzero/guard/leak. Serialized single-thread process; no direct existing children. Do not alter original module.
contract.receipts: <OUT>/<name>-exit.json plus raw <name>.log; inspect exit==0, guard is null, ownedChildrenAbsent true, finalOwnedPids/finalDirectChildren empty. run is sampled 4GiB RSS, 600s stage, 10s cleanup; not kernel enforcement. Browser-specific case inventory and schema restoration remain separate requirements.
